description.value: The Auberge Vancouver Hotel occupies the historic Terminal City Tower in downtown Vancouver, rising above Burrard Inlet with sweeping views of the harbour and North Shore mountains. It is a full-service luxury property featuring a 25-metre indoor pool, fitness centre, squash courts, saunas, and steam rooms, positioned steps from the Canada Place seawall and cycling paths leading toward Stanley Park. Touring cyclists will find the central location convenient to Vancouver's main waterfront cycling corridors and the historic streets of Gastown.
